# Yan Zhou    Senior Software Engineer

> (+86) 188-1782-8694 | i_ideas@outlook.com | Shanghai, CHN | Intel Asia-Pacific Research & Development Ltd.

## Professional Summary

With over six years of experience in software engineering at Intel AP R&D, I have honed my skills in CPU simulation, distributed system optimization and simulation, as well as cloud and big data cluster tuning and simulation. I possess a strong proficiency in C++/SystemC for high-performance development, alongside expertise in automation tools and big data frameworks. For two years, my performance has consistently exceeded expectations within the team. I hold a Master's degree in Electrical Engineering from Shanghai Jiao Tong University, graduating Magna Cum Laude, where I integrated hardware architecture theory with software engineering practice.

## Technical Stack

C++ | SystemC | Python | Java | full-stack simulation | Microarchitecture simulation (x86/GPGPU) | Big Data Clusters (Apache Spark, Hadoop, HIVE, Tez, etc.) | Artificial Intelligence (recommendation system, Horovod) | Cloud computing (Kubernetes, Docker, Elasticsearch, Prometheus, Grafana, etc.) | Microservices Architecture (Go, RPC, distributed tracing (Jaeger, OpenTracing)) | Profiling tools (VTune, Emon, Nmon) | Continuous Integration & Continuous Deployment (CI/CD, GitHub Action, Jenkins, TeamCity)

## Professional Experience

### Microarchitecture Simulation Development    Jun 2022 – present

#### 1. Intel Next-Generation Xeon Processor Diamond Rapids Simulation

**Personal Contributions on Uncore Modeling:**

- Designed and implemented fabric modules such as Mesh Fabric, Ring Fabric, and Dual Ring.
- Developed IP and fabric clock systems, along with global logging methodologies, statistical analyses, and post-processing modules.
- Crafted workload, topology, and trace generators, as well as parser modules.
- Conducted hotspots analysis concerning packets per cycle and bandwidth.

**Personal Contributions on Simulation Regression Framework:**

- Developed a distributed regression framework managing approximately 10,000 jobs nightly, utilized by global teams.
- Established a multi-layer testing framework encompassing Unit Testing (UT), Integration Testing (IT), and System Testing (ST), achieving a remarkable 99% code coverage and 90% automation in critical path testing.

**Personal Contributions on Performance Analysis & Optimization:**

- Harnessed VTune Amplifier and other tools such as Valgrind and code coverage for performance profiling, identifying and optimizing simulation model hotspots. Achieved a 35% enhancement in critical path execution efficiency and a simulation throughput 1.2 times higher than the industry benchmark.

#### 2. GPGPU Model Simulation

Responsible for modeling the microarchitecture of GPGPU computing units, memory controllers, and task schedulers, facilitating CUDA workload simulation with a focus on verifying resource scheduling strategies within heterogeneous computing scenarios.

### Microservices Cloud Architecture Performance Analysis & Simulation    Aug 2021 – Jun 2022

#### 1. Kubernetes Cluster Performance Optimization

Utilized the DeathStarBench benchmark suite to stress test microservices architecture. In resource-constrained environments (e.g., CPU/memory quota limits), successfully optimized Kubernetes scheduler policies, achieving a 28% reduction in average service response time and a 40% decrease in Pod eviction rate.

Developed a hierarchical monitoring system:

- **Infrastructure Layer:** Integrated Prometheus and Grafana to track node-level metrics like CPU, memory, and network IO.
- **Service Layer:** Implemented comprehensive tracing using OpenTelemetry/OpenTracing to identify latency hotspots in inter-service communications.
- **Application Layer:** Established a robust log analysis system utilizing the ELK Stack.

#### 2. Distributed Microservices Simulation Framework Development

**Design and Implementation:**

- Enabled dynamic service mesh modeling to simulate REST/gRPC calls, service registration/discovery (using Consul/Eureka), and advanced load balancing techniques such as Round Robin and Weighted Least Requests.
- Integrated K-means clustering for workload types, alongside a workload generator to create diverse workflows.
- Executed simulation of scheduling algorithms and enhanced performance hardware library to facilitate post-analysis in identifying bottlenecks and areas of pressure.

**Scalability Validation:**

Conducted simulations with over 1,000 microservices nodes to assess performance under various scaling strategies, including horizontal scaling (adding nodes), vertical scaling (upgrading instance specifications), and hybrid scaling.

Provided quantitative models showcasing throughput and latency relative to node count, supporting the design of data-driven architectures.

### Distributed System Performance Analysis & Acceleration & Simulation    Apr 2019 – Aug 2021

#### 1. Optane™ Memory and Big Data Toolset Optimization

- **Storage Performance Testing:** Executed comprehensive benchmark evaluations on Optane™ DC Persistent Memory.
- **Spark Cache Layer Optimization:** Implemented a hybrid storage architecture leveraging Optane™ as a cache layer for hot data while employing SSD/HDD for cold data. This strategy led to a 45% reduction in average Spark job execution time and a 30% decrease in memory usage.
- **Deep Integration of FSI:** Enhanced the integration of the financial services industry (FSI) tool with Spark, increasing task throughput by 60% and optimizing CPU utilization by 25%.

#### 2. Benchmark Testing & Performance Tuning

Developed a systematic approach for diagnosing distributed system performance utilizing flame graphs and lock contention analysis to pinpoint CPU-intensive processes (e.g., Shuffle phase) and IO bottlenecks (e.g., HDFS writes). Optimized over 30 Spark parameters, such as executor.memory and spark.sql.shuffle.partitions, elevating the job success rate from 82% to 98%.

#### 3. Apache Spark Simulation Framework Development

- **Framework Design:** Constructed a modular architecture including cluster topology modules that support both single and multi-rack deployments, along with workload generators simulating tasks like WordCount, PageRank, and FSI, etc. The framework features a performance prediction engine with customizable settings for node count, storage types (SSD/Optane™), and network bandwidth.
- **Model Calibration & Validation:** Calibrated simulation models with real cluster data (20 nodes, 100TB data), achieving prediction errors within ±8% for latency and ±5% for throughput to aid in accurate cluster capacity planning.
- **Extended Scenario Support:** Facilitated performance modeling for horizontal scaling (10→500 nodes), vertical scaling (8→64 CPU cores per node), and hybrid scaling, resulting in over 20 optimized resource configurations.

## Education

**M.A. | Electrical Engineering | Shanghai Jiao Tong University    2016 – 2019**

- Graduated Magna Cum Laude
- Merit Student and Outstanding Graduate

**B.A. | Electrical Engineering | Donghua University    2012 – 2016**

- Graduated Magna Cum Laude
- Outstanding Graduate

## Certifications & Honors

- Exceed Expectation (top 30% performance) — 2024
- Exceed Expectation (top 30% performance) — 2023

### Deploy to remote sites

```

More info: [Deployment](https://hexo.io/docs/one-command-deployment.html)
